episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When George keeps reliving the same few weeks over and over, he is offered an opportunity that will change his life forever.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: George is left distraught after a freak accident hurts someone close to him, but soon discovers the perils of turning back time at will.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A grieving George decides to take action. But what if the only person who can help him is The Lazarus Project's mortal enemy?

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: George puts his plan into motion, unaware that a Lazarus agent is hot on his heels - and is prepared to do anything to stop him.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: As George tries desperately to cover his tracks, his actions force Archie to question her faith in The Lazarus Project.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As George's plan is about to be executed, he is faced with a decision that will change countless lives and the world as he knows it forever.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: As the past begins to catch up with him, George learns that having the power to turn back time doesn't mean getting everything you want.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: When The Lazarus Project are trapped by a cataclysmic event, George discovers that the key to helping them is the person he has just shot.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: We pick up where the first series left off, with the world stuck in a seemingly infinite threeweek loop that will eventually end with global destruction. The Lazarus Project team is trying desperately to break the cycle - and this starts with finding the scientists who caused the singularity in the first place. Back at the Lazarus Project, George is fighting to win back the trust of both his colleagues and exgirlfriend, Sarah. But despite his return to the team, George has a growing suspicion about the Lazarus Project's alleged altruism and integrity. Will he once again have to choose between Lazarus and what he believes is right?

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: George and the other Lazarus Project agents attempt to track down the time machine that was used to send Janet back to 2012 - a machine powerful enough to break through the checkpoint and travel back further in time. But will they succeed in finding this impressive machine? The impending end of humanity isn't the only thing on the Lazarus agents' minds - romance is blossoming between some, while friendship and love is tested between others. And when an unexpected visitor from the past comes looking for George, he realises that the repercussions of unlimited time travel are further-reaching than anyone could ever have imagined…

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The Lazarus team gets closer to cracking the science behind time travel. However, what they don't know is that their mission isn't quite as straightforward as is making it out to be. Meanwhile, George learns first-hand about the repercussions of Wes unlimited time travel when unexpected visitors from the past track him down. Forced to reckon with the consequences that his future self has invoked, he goes further down the rabbit hole find the severity of his future self 's actions.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: When the time machine doesn't work in the way they'd planned, George and the other members of the Lazarus mission are left stranded in the wrong year – but could somebody be conspiring against them? As the team work to fix the technology that will allow them to continue their mission, they find it impossible to ignore the temptation to relive, and maybe even rewrite, their past. Confronted with a number of Lazarus Project secrets, George and the team look for answers from the past in the hope that they will fix the problems of the present.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: While the Lazarus team is trying to find its way back to 2012, Janet is already there, hard at work with Dr Gray. After being sent back to 2012 against her will, Janet has been tasked by the mysterious Time Break Initiative to fix the faulty time machine and ensure it won't cause the three-week loop in the future. With only her daughter, Becky, and her intimidating bodyguard, Bryson, for company, Janet gains the trust of Gray as they work together to develop the time machine. With the opportunity to rewrite time, will Janet try to prevent Dr Gray's impending assassination? And how will she view the part played by the Lazarus Project - and herself - in the tragic events that are to come?

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: After successfully arriving in 2012, George and the Lazarus team face their biggest challenge yet as they attempt to rescue Janet and retrieve the time machine. Time is ticking - Wes has been made aware of Dr Gray's and Janet's work – and she is hell-bent on destroying it. Unbeknownst to the team, one of their own is onto them - and their mission is about to take a very different turn…

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: When a catastrophic event severely compromises the Lazarus team's plans, George and Sarah must work together to execute their mission and are forced to go head-to-head with an unyielding Wes. Just when it's looking as though their entire mission has been futile, the pair realise that they have one last bargaining chip. But will they use it if it means abandoning their morals? And can George come to terms with the reality that he may not be the good guy after all?

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Things come to a head as missions, agents, and issues from the past and present collide in one epic confrontation. George and the other Lazarus agents have just one chance to try and save their own while fixing the threeweek loop once and for all. However, they know that if they succeed, what they do will change the future as they know it in ways they could never have imagined. And is that what every member of the team really wants?
